items.title: Search With Google
items.subtitle: Tap the Search tab's magnifier and pick Google to find Reddit threads, then open them right in Apollo.

items.title: Lighter and Faster
items.subtitle: Apollo uses less memory, frees it when iOS runs low, and does less work at launch.

items.title: Crash Fixes
items.subtitle: Fixes a feed crash when RedGIFs posts load together, and a crash tapping a translated deleted comment.

items.title: RedGIFs Keeps Playing
items.subtitle: Posts keep working after switching Wi-Fi, cellular, or VPN, and older videos play instead of showing an error.

items.title: Video Sound Behaves
items.subtitle: Feed sound stays on one video, doesn't start on screens you've left, and mutes while another video is fullscreen.

items.title: Accounts and Sign-In
items.subtitle: API-Key-Free feeds stop stalling on a spinner, avatars load for the right account, and Add Account uses your Settings key.

items.title: Comments
items.subtitle: A comment that can't post now says why, image comments post cleanly, and inline images don't jump when they load.
